subject: Kickoff: flare removal for the imaging pipeline
body:
Team — kicking off the flare removal track for the vision portfolio.

The ICCV method trains networks to remove lens flare, and the released code gives us both training and a standalone testing script (remove_flare.py). Product target: a post-capture cleanup feature for the imaging pipeline.

Milestones: (1) repro the released model's behavior by Apr 24 — note the repo's known history: a training-code issue was reported and a VGG-loss fix landed, so we validate that current code trains to published quality rather than assuming it; (2) retrain on our own capture data with our lens profiles through May; (3) on-device feasibility assessment in June; (4) launch-review pre-read by Jul 3.

Tereza owns training, Rafael data and quality, Farah infra, Yusuf the on-device path. Alina follows up on resourcing.

Lucia
